name: 2d-tote-bicolor-studio
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: high-resolution portrait product photograph for 2D1 website bag-study-photo.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing 2D Tote, the authoritative edit target for design, proportions and branding. Image 2 (gray/white NOMAD tote) is ONLY an angle/strap-drape reference. Image 3 (blue glossy tote) is ONLY a reference for convincing photographic light, surface detail and grounding; do not copy its bag design or shiny material.
Create ONE standalone photograph, one bag only, no collage, no layout, no captions. Portrait 3:4 composition, ideally 1536 x 2048 pixels. Entire shoulder strap, handles, bag bottom and red side tab visible with modest breathing room, product fills about 85% of frame height.
Preserve Image 1's wide rectangular body approx W40 H36 D10cm, box-gusset base, long broad sewn shoulder handle, small central hand handle, top seam, small soft-beige geometric embroidered 2D1 logo centered high on the front, small Icon Red #FF2B00 square woven tab projecting from the lower-left side seam. Keep the logo faithfully shaped like Image 1, real matte embroidery, not a shiny metallic badge. No extra pockets, buckles, snaps, long straps down the front, piping, text, other branding, or hardware.
Real heavy Japanese No.8 cotton canvas: visible woven warp/weft, slight fiber fuzz, irregular dye absorption, plausible seam stitching and tension puckers, gently asymmetric folds from gravity, subtle filled volume, soft but structured bag. The handles are sewn fabric, not leather. Photograph realism with restrained processing and believable contact shadow; avoid the inflated smoothness, repeated wrinkles, excessive grain and plastic sheen of a 3D render.
Background palette stays soft warm beige #FAF0E6; keep outer background calm and uncluttered. No person, hands, props, plants, signage or additional objects.

Variant design: body, shoulder strap OUTER face and short hand handle are deep ash brown, using #191416 as the unlit material color, naturally lighter on lit folds. The entire INNER/underside face of the long shoulder strap is Icon Red #FF2B00, sewn as a true two-sided fabric strap, not a red stripe or edge piping. Short hand handle stays ash brown, NOT red. Turn the bag to a gentle three-quarter angle like Image 2, about 20 degrees, and let the long strap twist naturally so a substantial broad red inner face and the ash-brown outer face can both be seen. Preserve all remaining details of Image 1.

Lighting and setting: meticulous real studio product photograph against a soft warm-beige #FAF0E6 seamless sweep. Large diffused side key from upper left, gentle negative fill on right, realistic bounce in folds, nuanced canvas highlights, faint soft contact shadow at base. Bag rests on the sweep with subtly compressed base; handles held in natural presentation shape. Full-frame 85mm product lens, f/8, restrained contrast, accurate cloth microtexture, no artificial glow, no wet look, no mirror reflection.
